name: Rangers
description: '''Rangers''' is a Czech [[Folk music|folk]] and [[country music]] band formed in 1964 by Milan Dufek and Antonín Hájek. Its classic lineup (1966–1969) also included Miroslav Řihošek, Jan Vančura, Jiří Veisser, Radek Tomášek, and Jarka Hadrabová. In 1971, they changed their name to '''Plavci''', reverting back to their original moniker in 1990. Rangers – Plavci released numerous studio, live, and compilation albums. Dufek died in 2005, and in 2013, the group fractured into several separate ensembles.
